S4-01.text:
IT earnings roundup
TCS posted record profit and raised guidance. Infosys cut its revenue outlook and shares tumbled. Wipro reported flat revenue and no change to guidance.

S4-02.text:
Banks in focus
HDFC Bank reported a strong rise in profit. ICICI Bank saw a sharp spike in bad loans. SBI announced the date of its board meeting.

S4-03.text:
Auto sales update
Maruti Suzuki sales jumped 20% in October, a record. Bajaj Auto sales fell 15% and missed estimates. Reliance announced the appointment of a new director.

S4-04.text:
Metals and energy wrap
Tata Steel reported a wider loss and cut its output target. JSW Steel posted a sharp rise in profit and record volumes. Reliance said its annual general meeting will be held next month.

S4-05.text:
Tech and finance
HCL Technologies won a large multi-year contract and shares surged. Infosys lost a major client and profit fell. HDFC Bank held its dividend unchanged.
